unrecoverable.base.digest: The SIF was built with `apptainer build docker-archive://wbm-v1-full.tar` from a Docker-saved tar that deploy_to_anvil.sh deletes after the build, and no base-image registry digest survives anywhere in the artifact — the deffile only names the local tar (`bootstrap: docker-archive` / `from: wbm-v1-full.tar`), and the only base-related label is `org.opencontainers.image.ref.name: ubuntu` / `org.opencontainers.image.version: 20.04`, a tag rather than a digest.
